hero.title: About
hero.subtitle: Pre-final-year Information Technology student at IIIT Gwalior, graduating in May 2028. I completed a year at QuickIntell working on healthcare document processing, X12 835 generation, product features, testing, and production debugging.

aboutSections.title: Background
content: I am Nishant Harkut, a pre-final-year student in the Integrated Dual Degree Information Technology program at IIIT Gwalior. I started with Product Design and UI/UX, then moved into software engineering because I wanted to build and ship the products I was designing to actual users.

aboutSections.title: QuickIntell
content: I completed a year on a healthcare revenue-cycle platform that turns EOB documents into X12 835 ERA files and gives operations teams upload, review, and correction flows.

I wrote 19 payer-specific Python parsers that lifted field extraction from roughly 55% to 95% on evaluated payer workflows, taking support from 44 to 71 formats. I also corrected output across 44 ERA generators and delivered 40+ product and security changes through five review rounds.

aboutSections.title: Projects and research
content: Outside internships, I build products end to end. PocketBuddy combines a Kotlin Android connector, FastAPI, React, and AWS event processing. I am also working on faculty-supervised research in TinyML security and respiratory-audio reliability.

aboutSections.title: Open source
content: I have 16 merged pull requests across Learning Unlimited, Kiwix, and the Palisadoes Foundation. The work includes regression tests, accessibility fixes, dependency cleanup, and React refactors shaped by maintainer review.

aboutSections.title: Off the keyboard
content: I play basketball, train at the gym, experiment with music, and still make some time for graphic design and photography.
